steps.title: Send the Astro project's sources
steps.note: The project has an astro.config.mjs, so the bundler builds it with the Astro builder first: the config and its integrations run, the .astro files are compiled by compiler-rs, the server and client bundles are made, then the server entry is bundled into one Worker like any project. No node_modules and no dist/ are sent.

request.body: a ZIP of 11 files (5.1 KiB): README.md, astro.config.mjs, package.json, src/components/Counter.tsx, src/env.d.ts, src/pages/api/time.ts, src/pages/index.astro, src/pages/posts/[slug].astro, src/worker.ts, tsconfig.json, wrangler.jsonc

steps.title: The output: a Worker and its client assets
wrangler.json
steps.note: The project's Durable Object, plus what Astro's Cloudflare adapter adds: the assets binding and a SESSION KV namespace (with a stable id, which celld requires).

steps.title: Run the output: the home page, rendered on the server
steps.note: The page reads the visit count from the Visits Durable Object before it renders. The <astro-island> holds the React counter.
